# Research 1: mechanics

## Mechanics

Blood Hunt is a spear attack that consumes Blood Loss.[^m1] Rage builds on hit and pays out on the next attacks.[^m2]

- i1a-1 | Blood Hunt | skill | role: layer | needs: a spear | conflicts: none | lookup_game_data gem "Blood Hunt" | not modelled | on: r1-a-1, r1-a-2
- i1a-2 | Bloodlust | support | role: scaler of Blood Hunt | needs: an attack | conflicts: none | lookup_game_data gem "Bloodlust" | modelled | on: r1-a-1
- i1a-3 | Herald of Blood | skill | role: layer | needs: any | conflicts: none | lookup_game_data gem "Herald of Blood" | modelled | on: r1-a-1
